baseline_protocol: A002-compatible same-binary schema ablation; generic typed placement contract.
candidate_protocol: same binary with conservative placement advisor enabled.
control_fixture_amendment: The unavailable managed checkout was explicitly classified as a protected refusal control with a declared trigger; prompt and verifier remained unchanged. Six paired control rows were rerun under the residual approved budget and substituted before final scoring.
decision_rationale: NO-GO: candidate and baseline both had zero independently verified task successes and the protected unavailable-checkout control failed in all six runs. The advisor showed no substantive correctness improvement; favorable reliability/duration movement cannot qualify it under the scoring contract.
limitations: All 36 task schedule rows plus six supplemental protected-control rows were attempted; no hidden verifier passed.
No stable correctness rule improved outcomes; reliability and median duration moved favorably but are advisory under the frozen scoring contract.

The unavailable-checkout negative control was initially misclassified; its explicit protected classification was added as a scoring-only fixture amendment and its six arms were rerun. The task prompt and verifier were unchanged.
ACP does not expose scheduler queue wait or exclusive-lease collision outcomes, so no scheduler-wait or collision-reduction claim is made.
OpenCode Go allowance is provider-reported after each response; the 10 USD aggregate cap was enforced by controller receipts with one in-flight inference at a time.
